title: ALM ABUSE IN TEAMSPEAK

replies.author: ALM
replies.body:
A couple things,

The last account logged into Avicus from the IP you connected to TS with was indeed AutoTool. You were kicked prior by Prodigy for not changing your name and did not confirm it with him that your name was indeed this in game. This is why we have the registration process in the first place. Since we have no record that this account is you and since your last account on record is AutoTool, the punishment stands.

I would recommend registering in TeamSpeak with the name you plan to use.

Appeal DENIED.
